headline: HyperX is known for peripherals, but they're expanding into PCs too. Buy select AMD Ryzen
body: HyperX is known for peripherals, but they're expanding into PCs too. Buy select AMD Ryzen or AMD Radeon products, or desktops like the HyperX OMEN 45L to get a Steam key for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. Purchase required while supplies last. Presented by.
